title: ScriptSegmentManifest
description: A script segment manifest, `segments/<id>.toml` in a script plugin.

command.description: The script, relative to the plugin root; run by `/bin/sh`.

description.description: One line shown by `gpy plugin validate`.

env.description: Extra environment variables forwarded to the script and keyed in the cache.

inputs.description: Public shell values passed as `GPY_<NAME>`; `pwd` makes the cache per folder.

require_command.description: A script, relative to the plugin root, that must exit 0; run last.

require_env.description: Every variable must be set and non-empty in the shell.

require_extensions.description: Every extension must match a file in the working directory itself.

require_folders.description:
Every name must exist as a folder in the working directory or an ancestor,
with the same stop as `require_files`.

settings.description: Typed settings, passed as `GPY_OPT_<key>` and overridable in `config.toml`.

timeout_ms.description: Run time limit in milliseconds (default and maximum 500).

ttl_secs.description: Seconds a result is reused (default 5; `0` disables the cache).

Extension.description: A file extension for `require_extensions`, without the leading dot.

InputName.description:
A public shell value a script can declare in `inputs`.

Each reaches the script as `GPY_<NAME>`; only declared inputs are set and
only they are part of the cache key.

oneOf.description:
The shell's working directory; the script then runs in it and the
cache becomes per folder.
`1` when the shell runs as root, else `0`.
The last command's duration in milliseconds; empty before the first command.
The glyph mode: `nerd` (Nerd Font icons) or `ascii`.

ScanName.description: One file or folder name searched for by `require_files`/`require_folders`.

ScriptPath.description:
A plugin-relative path to a POSIX `sh` script (`command`, `require_command`).

Syntax is checked at parse; [`ScriptPath::resolve`] checks that it names a
file that stays inside the plugin root after symlinks.

default.description: Value when the user sets none.
Value when the user sets none.

choices.description: The accepted values; empty accepts any string.

default.description: Value when the user sets none.

TimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds a script may run before it is killed and the segment hidden.

TtlSecs.description: Seconds a script result is reused; `0` runs the script on every due prompt.
